capacity.stableProgress: Confirmed: {0:0.#}/6 percentage points, {1}/2 blocks. Each block needs at least 3 points and later quota and log confirmation (at least 2 minutes).
capacity.stableNote: v4: pair non-overlapping blocks of at least 3 percentage points; confirm endpoints using later quota and an index scan at least 2 minutes later. Weekly API-equivalent value = total priced cost × 100 / total paired percentage points. Late logs replace the affected blocks. Account, plan, pricing and reset boundaries remain separate. The reference range describes block variability, not official dollar credit or a statistical confidence interval; it may widen as usage changes. Old results remain historical references until two new blocks are ready.

capacity.changed: Data or account changed. Discarded outdated results; waiting for the next batch.
capacity.failed: Calculation failed; previous results retained. Retry or inspect diagnostics.
attribution.explanation: Current filtered range only. Unassigned means continuous login evidence is missing, possibly while the app was closed, starting, or verifying the account. Old logs cannot prove the exact cause; this does not imply another account. Confirmation applies only to previewed unassigned records on the selected date, never other accounts or source logs. A database backup is created first.

attribution.retry: Data or account may have changed. Wait for scanning/refresh to finish and preview again.
attribution.done: Ownership confirmed and backup saved. Matching intervals will be recalculated in the next batch.
attribution.unchanged: Confirmation did not complete. Preview again; transactional updates prevent partial writes.
capacity.retentionNote: Quota snapshots and pairing details are cleaned daily, retaining 30 days and complete pairing segments (sometimes longer). Token totals, raw logs and estimate results are retained. Purged details cannot be recalculated from old snapshots. Freed database pages are reused; file size may not shrink immediately.
capacity.batchNote: Recalculate every 5 minutes when data changes, retaining the previous result while waiting. Opening the panel does not trigger calculation. Quota refresh and log collection continue normally.

s0F58A8B1B0E1:
Token capacity = eligible interval tokens / corresponding weekly percentage points used × 100. Dollar estimates use API-equivalent costs from the same interval; missing prices yield partial estimates.
Each query time and unrounded percentage is saved. Pairing uses (start, end], retaining the start while usage is flat. User-confirmed attribution and late logs replace recomputed intervals rather than adding duplicates. Missing timestamps or endpoints, account/plan/reset boundaries and unverified ownership are excluded.
Query timestamps are local receipt times; log timestamps identify usage events, not exact per-token billing times. Other devices, model mix and service reporting delays affect accuracy. This is not an official quota or balance.
Only general quota is estimated; Spark is excluded. Offline usage requires matching endpoints in the same window and confirmed ownership. Missing legacy snapshots cannot be fabricated. After a reset, the previous estimate is a dated reference only.
